item.title: Ken Carson Sets July Release Date for New Album ‘xperiment’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news. Today, we're talking about Ken Carson, the Atlanta-born rapper who's been making waves in the industry.
[Music transitions to a brief clip of Ken Carson's song]
Host: Carson has just announced his new album, xperiment, set to drop on July 3rd via Opium/Interscope Records. To tease the project, he's released a short film, giving fans a glimpse of what's to come.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: This announcement comes on the heels of a milestone week for Carson. He recently joined Playboi Carti on stage at Summer Smash in Chicago, where they performed their unreleased track "Cover My Ears". And, he's been announced as a headliner for ComplexCon 2026 in Los Angeles.
[Music transitions to a brief clip of Ken Carson's previous work]
Host: xperiment follows Carson's 2025 Billboard 200 No. 1 album, More Chaos. That album debuted at No. 1 with 59,500 equivalent album units, marking a major milestone in his career. He's also had success with previous albums, including A Great Chaos and X.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: Carson has been building momentum with his performances, including a career-defining show at Rolling Loud Orlando 2026. He's also made headlines with his fashion collaborations and sold-out touring, including an 80-date Chaos World Tour.
[Music transitions to a brief clip of Ken Carson's upcoming tour]
Host: This summer, Carson will be performing at several European festivals, including Roskilde in Denmark and Splash! in Germany. With his new album on the horizon, it's clear that Ken Carson is an artist to watch.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. We'll be keeping an eye on Ken Carson and his upcoming album, xperiment. Stay tuned for more music news and updates. [Outro music continues to play until the end]
